essence: By holding the charm, one gains a very auspicious and long-lived son.
By the grace of the armor, a chaste woman may become one whose children live.
Likewise, the son of Dhārikā is unconquerable even by the deathless ones.
The speaker asks for the compassionate revelation of the armor named for gaining lineage.
By the grace of this armor, Kamalā obtained an excellent son.
